note: Equipment review: the Calderilla telegrams describe Berenguela firing a broadside and Chilean infantry firing from shore. The screw-and-sail hull and long-arm infantry are equipment analogies; they do not reconstruct the frigate, its launches, uniforms or the full coastal force.
